annotations.description:
Client-specified annotations. This is distinct from labels.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_annotations' for all of the annotations present on the resource.
annotations.rationale: Annotation are to store extra metadata about workstation. They do not directly control access or security behaviour for the workstation

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.rationale: Display name is mainly used as a human-readable identifier and does not directly control workstation security settings.

env.description: 'Client-specified environment variables passed to the workstation container's entrypoint.'
env.rationale: env does not affect security behaviour.

labels.description:
Client-specified labels that are applied to the resource and that are also propagated to the underlying Compute Engine resources.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are mainly used for organisation, identification, and cost tracking. They do not directly control access or security behaviour for the workstation.

location.description: The location where the workstation parent resources reside.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project can affect governance and resource ownership, but this workstation policy set does not validate approved project IDs.

source_workstation.description:
Full resource name of the source workstation from which the workstation's persistent
directories will be cloned from during creation.
source_workstation.rationale: Source workstation cloning may affect data inheritance, but this policy set does not validate approved source workstations.

workstation_cluster_id.description: The ID of the parent workstation cluster.
workstation_cluster_id.rationale: Identifier referencing the parent workstation cluster. This is a reference to another resource and is not a security policy target.

workstation_config_id.description: The ID of the parent workstation cluster config.
workstation_config_id.rationale: Identifier referencing the workstation config the workstation uses. This is a reference to another resource; we do not constrain which config is referenced.

workstation_id.description: ID to use for the workstation.
workstation_id.rationale: Identifier for the workstation. We do not constrain resource identifiers or naming conventions, so it is not a security policy target.
